svg.text: mesh-msg handheld, Model P — schematic overview (rev A draft)
ESP32-P4 + ESP32-C6 + 5" MIPI touchscreen. GPIO numbers are a suggestion: verify against the ESP32-P4 datasheet. ± = differential pair drawn as one line.
host: 5 V boost → VBUS_C, connector cut from the PMU input;
MK1 analog MEMS mic (1µF series C)
AEC reference: speaker signal back into the right ADC
Cellular: SIM7600G-H (4G LTE Cat-4, 3G/2G, GNSS) — modem I/O is 1.8 V
PWRKEY, RESET: NPN open collector Q3 / Q4 (pulled to GND from the expander side)
DTR, STATUS, RI, FLIGHTMODE: through U19 TXS0104E (1.8 V ↔ 3.3 V), not drawn
mesh-msg handheld · Model P (P4 + C6 + LTE)
Rev A draft · 2026-11-13 · not for fabrication
Design notes, BOM and pin rules: docs/handheld.md
